::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 17th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 20
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),

I am sorry to trouble you again, but will you kindly tell me how to answer the letter from [Mrs Blackburn](people/person_159.qmd) about the Illustrations to the [Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd), which I sent about ten days ago - You see she says it must be settled quickly as she is going abroad

Yours faithfully
<C.M. Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
